evidence.source_statement: For a distributed fork release, identify the fork revision, followed upstream revision, retained deviations and materially relevant imported fixes in public release metadata so downstream users can determine exactly what was shipped.
source_conditions: This published requirement is applicable only to the expressly authorized Rust fork maintenance and its declared source or public contract.
